english.description: Mojito: a fresh & fizzy classic featuring rum. Gather the ingredients and follow the steps to mix your own.
steps: Gently muddle mint, sugar and lime juice in a highball glass.
Add a little soda water and cracked ice, then pour in the white rum.
Top up with soda water.
Garnish with mint leaves and a lemon slice.

name: Last Word
description: 最后一句，一款以金酒为主角、呈现草本清冽风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将所列液体材料放入加冰的摇酒壶，充分摇匀。
滤入预先冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。

english.description: Last Word is a herbal & crisp cocktail featuring gin. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake the listed liquid ingredients with ice to combine and chill.
Strain the mixture into a chilled cocktail glass.

name: Mai-Tai
description: 迈泰，一款以朗姆酒为主角、呈现果香甜润风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将所列液体材料放入加冰的摇酒壶，充分摇匀。
连冰倒入双份古典杯或高球杯。
以菠萝长条、薄荷及青柠皮装饰。

english.description: Mai-Tai is a fruity & mellow cocktail featuring rum. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake the listed liquid ingredients with ice to combine and chill.
Pour the drink with its ice into a double rocks or highball glass.
Garnish with a pineapple spear, mint and lime peel.

zh: 此版本使用马提尼克糖蜜朗姆酒，与农业朗姆酒不同。
en: This version calls for Martinique molasses rum, which is distinct from agricole rhum.

name: Martinez
description: 马丁内斯，一款以金酒为主角、呈现苦甜浓郁风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将材料与冰块放入搅拌杯，搅拌至冰镇。
滤入预先冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。
以柠檬皮装饰。

english.description: Martinez is a bold & bittersweet cocktail featuring gin. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Combine the ingredients with ice in a mixing glass and stir until chilled.
Strain the mixture into a chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with lemon zest before serving.

name: Mint Julep
description: 薄荷朱莉普，一款以威士忌为主角、呈现草本清冽风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 在金属朱莉普杯中轻压薄荷、糖粉和水。
加满碎冰，倒入波本威士忌，充分搅拌至杯身结霜。
以薄荷枝装饰。

english.description: Mint Julep is a herbal & crisp cocktail featuring whiskey. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Gently muddle the mint, powdered sugar and water in a metal julep cup.
Fill with cracked ice, add bourbon and stir until the outside of the cup frosts.
Garnish with a fresh mint sprig before serving.

name: Missionary's Downfall
description: 传教士的堕落，一款以朗姆酒为主角、呈现果香甜润风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将全部材料与半杯碎冰放入搅拌机。
搅打均匀，倒入大碟形酒杯。
以薄荷枝和菠萝片装饰。

english.description: Missionary's Downfall is a fruity & mellow cocktail featuring rum. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Place all the ingredients in a blender with half a cup of crushed ice.
Blend until combined and pour into a large coupe glass.
Garnish with a mint sprig and a pineapple slice.

name: Monkey Gland
description: 猴腺，一款以金酒为主角、呈现果香甜润风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将所列液体材料放入加冰的摇酒壶，充分摇匀。
滤入预先冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。

english.description: Monkey Gland is a fruity & mellow cocktail featuring gin. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake the listed liquid ingredients with ice to combine and chill.
Strain the mixture into a chilled cocktail glass.

name: Naked and Famous
description: 裸露与名气，一款以梅斯卡尔为主角、呈现草本清冽风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将所列液体材料放入加冰的摇酒壶，充分摇匀。
滤入预先冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。

english.description: Naked and Famous is a herbal & crisp cocktail featuring mezcal. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake the listed liquid ingredients with ice to combine and chill.
Strain the mixture into a chilled cocktail glass.

name: New York Sour
description: 纽约酸，一款以威士忌为主角、呈现清新酸甜风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 除红酒外，将材料加冰用力摇匀。
滤入装有新冰块的冰镇古典杯。
将红酒缓缓浮在表面，保留分层。
以柠檬皮或橙皮及樱桃装饰。

english.description: New York Sour is a bright & citrusy cocktail featuring whiskey. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake all ingredients except the red wine vigorously with ice.
Strain into a chilled rocks glass filled with fresh ice.
Carefully float the red wine on top to keep the layers separate.
Garnish with citrus zest and a cherry before serving.

name: Old Cuban
description: 老古巴，一款以朗姆酒为主角、呈现清爽气泡风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 除起泡酒外，将材料放入摇酒壶，加冰摇匀。
滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯，加入香槟或普罗塞克。
以薄荷枝装饰。

english.description: Old Cuban is a fresh & fizzy cocktail featuring rum. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake all ingredients except the sparkling wine with ice.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass and finish with champagne or prosecco.
Garnish with a mint sprig before serving.

name: Paloma
description: 帕洛玛，一款以龙舌兰为主角、呈现清爽气泡风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将龙舌兰和青柠汁倒入高球杯。
加入冰块和盐，再倒入粉红西柚汽水，轻轻搅拌。
以青柠片装饰。

english.description: Paloma is a fresh & fizzy cocktail featuring tequila. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Pour tequila and lime juice into a highball glass.
Add ice and salt, pour in the pink grapefruit soda and stir gently.
Garnish with a lime slice before serving.

name: Paper Plane
description: 纸飞机，一款以威士忌为主角、呈现清新酸甜风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将所列液体材料放入加冰的摇酒壶，充分摇匀。
滤入预先冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。

english.description: Paper Plane is a bright & citrusy cocktail featuring whiskey. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake the listed liquid ingredients with ice to combine and chill.
Strain the mixture into a chilled cocktail glass.

description: 天堂，一款以金酒为主角、呈现果香甜润风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。

english.description: Paradise is a fruity & mellow cocktail featuring gin. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake the listed liquid ingredients with ice to combine and chill.
Strain the mixture into a chilled cocktail glass.

name: Penicillin
description: 盘尼西林，一款以威士忌为主角、呈现清新酸甜风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 在摇酒壶中轻压姜片，加入除乐加维林外的材料。
加冰摇匀，细滤入放有冰块的冰镇古典杯。
将乐加维林威士忌缓缓浮在表面。
以糖渍姜片装饰。

english.description: Penicillin is a bright & citrusy cocktail featuring whiskey. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Muddle the ginger in a shaker and add the ingredients except the Lagavulin whisky.
Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled rocks glass over fresh ice.
Gently float the Lagavulin whisky on top of the drink.
Garnish with slices of candied ginger before serving.

name: Pisco Punch
description: 皮斯科潘趣，一款以皮斯科为主角、呈现果香甜润风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 轻压糖浆与丁香，加入除白葡萄酒外的材料。
加冰用力摇匀，双重过滤到大酒杯中。
倒入白葡萄酒，轻轻搅拌。

english.description: Pisco Punch is a fruity & mellow cocktail featuring pisco. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Gently crush the cloves with syrup, then add the other ingredients except the white wine.
Shake vigorously with ice and double-strain into a large goblet.
Add the dry white wine and stir gently to combine.

name: Pisco Sour
description: 皮斯科酸，一款以皮斯科为主角、呈现清新酸甜风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将皮斯科、柠檬汁、糖浆和蛋清放入摇酒壶，加冰摇匀。
滤入冰镇的高脚酒杯。
在表面滴少许阿玛格苦精增香。

english.description: Pisco Sour is a bright & citrusy cocktail featuring pisco. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake pisco, lemon juice, syrup and egg white with ice in a cocktail shaker.
Strain the mixture into a chilled goblet glass.
Add a few dashes of Amargo bitters on top as an aromatic garnish.

name: Planters Punch
description: 种植园主潘趣，一款以朗姆酒为主角、呈现果香甜润风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将牙买加朗姆酒、青柠汁和甘蔗汁倒入小酒杯或陶杯。
按口味用冰、水或果汁调节稀释度。
以橙皮装饰。

english.description: Planters Punch is a fruity & mellow cocktail featuring rum. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Pour Jamaican rum, lime juice and sugar cane juice into a small tumbler or terracotta cup.
Adjust the dilution to taste with ice, water or fresh juice.
Garnish with orange zest before serving.

name: Porn Star Martini
description: 激情之星马天尼，一款以伏特加为主角、呈现果香甜润风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 除香槟外，将材料加冰摇匀。
双重过滤到冰镇的大鸡尾酒杯。
香槟另盛小杯，搭配饮用，不倒进摇酒壶。
以百香果及糖装饰。

english.description: Porn Star Martini is a fruity & mellow cocktail featuring vodka. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake all ingredients except the champagne with ice.
Double-strain into a large chilled cocktail glass.
Serve the champagne separately in a small glass alongside the cocktail.
Garnish with passion fruit and sugar before serving.

name: Porto Flip
description: 波特翻转，一款以白兰地为主角、呈现奶油柔滑风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将所列液体材料放入加冰的摇酒壶，充分摇匀。
滤入预先冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。
表面撒少许现磨肉豆蔻。

english.description: Porto Flip is a creamy & smooth cocktail featuring brandy. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake the listed liquid ingredients with ice to combine and chill.
Strain the mixture into a chilled cocktail glass.
Finish with a little freshly grated nutmeg.

name: Rabo de Galo
description: 公鸡尾，一款以卡莎萨为主角、呈现苦甜浓郁风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 在酒杯中放入冰块，加入所列材料。
轻轻搅拌，让材料充分混合。
以橙皮装饰。

english.description: Rabo de Galo is a bold & bittersweet cocktail featuring cachaça. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Fill the serving glass with ice, then add the listed ingredients.
Stir gently to combine the ingredients without losing their texture.
Garnish with an orange twist before serving.

name: Ramos Fizz
description: 拉莫斯菲士，一款以金酒为主角、呈现奶油柔滑风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 除苏打水外，将材料加冰摇和两分钟。
双重过滤后倒回摇酒壶，不加冰，再用力摇和一分钟。
滤入高球杯，以苏打水补满。

english.description: Ramos Fizz is a creamy & smooth cocktail featuring gin. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake all ingredients except soda water with ice for two minutes.
Double-strain back into the shaker and shake hard without ice for another minute.
Strain into a highball glass and top up with soda water.

name: Remember the Maine
description: 缅因号记忆，一款以威士忌为主角、呈现苦甜浓郁风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 用苦艾酒润洗碟形杯，倒掉多余酒液。
将其余材料与冰块搅拌至冰镇，滤入处理好的酒杯。
以柠檬皮装饰。

english.description: Remember the Maine is a bold & bittersweet cocktail featuring whiskey. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Coat a coupe glass with absinthe and discard the excess.
Stir the remaining ingredients with ice until chilled, then strain into the rinsed glass.
Garnish with lemon zest before serving.

name: Russian Spring Punch
description: 俄罗斯春日潘趣，一款以伏特加为主角、呈现清爽气泡风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 除起泡酒外，将材料加冰摇匀。
滤入装有冰块的冰镇高杯，以起泡酒补满。
以黑莓装饰，可另加柠檬片。

english.description: Russian Spring Punch is a fresh & fizzy cocktail featuring vodka. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake all ingredients except the sparkling wine with ice.
Strain into a chilled tall glass over ice and top up with sparkling wine.
Garnish with blackberries and an optional lemon slice.

name: Sherry Cobbler
description: 雪莉考布勒，一款以葡萄酒为主角、呈现果香甜润风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将雪莉酒、糖及柠檬、橙子切片放入加冰的摇酒壶。
快速摇匀，滤入装满碎冰的朱莉普杯。
以浆果和柑橘切片装饰，搭配吸管。

english.description: Sherry Cobbler is a fruity & mellow cocktail featuring wine. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Add the sherries, sugar and sliced orange and lemon to a shaker with ice.
Shake briskly and strain into a julep cup filled with crushed ice.
Garnish with fresh berries and citrus slices. Serve with a straw.

name: South Side
description: 南区，一款以金酒为主角、呈现草本清冽风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将全部材料加入摇酒壶，加冰摇匀；加入可选蛋清时需充分摇和。
双重过滤到冰镇鸡尾酒杯。
以薄荷枝装饰。

english.description: South Side is a herbal & crisp cocktail featuring gin. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake the ingredients with ice, shaking vigorously if using the optional egg white.
Double-strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with a mint sprig before serving.

name: Spicy Fifty
description: 香辣五十，一款以伏特加为主角、呈现辛香咸鲜风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将材料与红辣椒片一起放入摇酒壶，加冰摇匀。
双重过滤到冰镇鸡尾酒杯。
以红辣椒装饰。

english.description: Spicy Fifty is a spicy & savory cocktail featuring vodka. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake the ingredients, including the chili slices, with ice.
Double-strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with a red chili pepper before serving.

name: Suffering Bastard
description: 受苦之人，一款以混合基酒为主角、呈现清爽气泡风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 除姜汁啤酒外，将材料加冰摇匀。
连冰倒入柯林斯杯或陶杯，以姜汁啤酒补满。
以薄荷枝装饰，可加橙片。

english.description: Suffering Bastard is a fresh & fizzy cocktail featuring mixed spirits. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake all ingredients except ginger beer with ice.
Pour unstrained into a Collins glass or mug and top up with ginger beer.
Garnish with a mint sprig and an optional orange slice.

name: Three Dots and a Dash
description: 三点一划，一款以朗姆酒为主角、呈现果香甜润风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将全部材料与约十二盎司碎冰放入搅拌机。
短暂搅打，倒入带脚高杯，再补入碎冰。
以三颗樱桃和一块长方形菠萝装饰。

english.description: Three Dots and a Dash is a fruity & mellow cocktail featuring rum. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Add the ingredients to a blender with about twelve ounces of crushed ice.
Flash blend, pour into a footed copo glass and finish with more crushed ice.
Garnish with three cherries and a rectangular piece of pineapple.

name: Tipperary
description: 蒂珀雷里，一款以威士忌为主角、呈现草本清冽风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将材料与冰块放入搅拌杯，搅拌至冰镇。
滤入预先冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。
以橙片装饰。

english.description: Tipperary is a herbal & crisp cocktail featuring whiskey. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Combine the ingredients with ice in a mixing glass and stir until chilled.
Strain the mixture into a chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with an orange slice before serving.

name: Trinidad Sour
description: 特立尼达酸，一款以苦精为主角、呈现苦甜浓郁风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将所列液体材料放入加冰的摇酒壶，充分摇匀。
滤入预先冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。

english.description: Trinidad Sour is a bold & bittersweet cocktail featuring bitters. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake the listed liquid ingredients with ice to combine and chill.
Strain the mixture into a chilled cocktail glass.

name: Tuxedo
description: 燕尾服，一款以金酒为主角、呈现草本清冽风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将材料与冰块放入搅拌杯，搅拌至冰镇。
滤入预先冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。
以樱桃和柠檬皮装饰。

english.description: Tuxedo is a herbal & crisp cocktail featuring gin. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Combine the ingredients with ice in a mixing glass and stir until chilled.
Strain the mixture into a chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with a cherry and lemon zest before serving.

name: Ve.N.To
description: 威尼托，一款以格拉帕为主角、呈现清新酸甜风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将所列液体材料放入加冰的摇酒壶，充分摇匀。
滤入装有新冰块的冰镇小酒杯。
以柠檬皮和白葡萄装饰。

english.description: Ve.N.To is a bright & citrusy cocktail featuring grappa. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Shake the listed liquid ingredients with ice to combine and chill.
Strain into a chilled small tumbler filled with fresh ice.
Garnish with lemon zest and white grapes before serving.

zh: 蜂蜜混合液中的水可按原文说明改用洋甘菊浸泡液。
en: The source allows chamomile infusion in place of water in the honey mix.

name: Vieux Carré
description: 老广场，一款以混合基酒为主角、呈现苦甜浓郁风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将材料与冰块放入搅拌杯，搅拌至冰镇。
滤入预先冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。
以橙皮和马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。

english.description: Vieux Carré is a bold & bittersweet cocktail featuring mixed spirits. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Combine the ingredients with ice in a mixing glass and stir until chilled.
Strain the mixture into a chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with orange zest and a maraschino cherry.

name: Zombie
description: 僵尸，一款以朗姆酒为主角、呈现果香甜润风味的调酒。按所列用量准备材料，再跟着步骤完成。
steps: 将全部材料和一百七十克碎冰放入搅拌机。
使用脉冲模式短暂搅打，倒入高杯。
以薄荷叶装饰。

english.description: Zombie is a fruity & mellow cocktail featuring rum. Measure the listed ingredients and follow the method to mix your own.
steps: Add all ingredients to an electric blender with 170 grams of cracked ice.
Pulse-blend briefly and pour into a tall tumbler glass.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves before serving.

zh: 唐氏混合汁：新鲜黄色西柚汁与肉桂糖浆按 2:1 混合。
en: Donn’s mix uses two parts fresh yellow grapefruit juice to one part cinnamon syrup.
